method: Written by hand from one frame per second (frame round(s * fps) of clip.mp4), viewed with a pixel grid. Not from YOLO or any other detector.
camera: drift up to 124 px measured on the leaves (the sky has no corners): handheld or wind-blown
notes: Backlit silhouette, low contrast colour. 50 fps.

birds.notes: sunbird-like silhouette on a leaf tip against an overcast dusk sky; turns and preens, never leaves
